condition_other: diabetic neuropathic pain (streptozotocin diabetic foot ulcer model)
readout_other: Von Frey paw withdrawal threshold; hot-plate paw withdrawal latency; sciatic nerve compound action potential conduction velocity; H&E staining of sciatic nerve; wound closure; PC12 live/dead staining
direction_notes: After 14 daily sessions the multiple-treatment group had higher paw withdrawal threshold and latency than the sham and control groups; nerve conduction velocity was higher than in the multiple-sham group but lower than in the untreated control group. A single session had no significant effect.
safety_notes: H&E staining of sciatic nerve showed no apparent damage and PC12 cell viability was unchanged after up to 30 min of exposure; skin temperature on a human forearm rose 0.3 to 0.4 degC over 5 min.

exposures.label: w-SUP 1.5 MHz pulsed thermal stimulation of the sciatic nerve

device.model: wearable spiral ultrasound patch (w-SUP), 41-element PZT-4 phyllotaxis array, driven via Verasonics Vantage HIFU system and a Keysight 33500B generator with AF Instrumentation 100A400A amplifier

timing.protocol_description: Waveform generator set at 1.5 MHz, 600 mVpp, 20 burst cycles and an 80% duty cycle, with the amplifier at 80% gain; a 5-min session once a day, single session on day 1 for the ST group and daily from day 1 to day 14 for the MT group.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Male Sprague-Dawley rats (n = 30) were randomly assigned into five groups, including control group (n = 6), ST group (n = 6), SS group (n = 6), MT group (n = 6), and MS group (n = 6)
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: The treatment protocols for the single-treatment (ST) and multiple-treatment (MT) groups are shown in Figure S10. In the ST group, DNP was quantified on day 0 and day 1, with the w-SUP treatment administered on day 1. In the multiple-treatment group (MT), DNP was quantified on day 0, day 7, and day 14, with the w-SUP treatments administered daily from day 1 to day 14.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The ultrasound patch was electrically connected to a waveform generator (33500B; Keysight, USA), set at a frequency of 1.5 MHz, an amplitude of 600 mVpp, 20 burst cycles, and an 80% duty cycle, along with a power amplifier (model 100A400A; AF Instrumentation, USA) set to 80% gain
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: The ultrasound patch was electrically connected to a waveform generator (33500B; Keysight, USA), set at a frequency of 1.5 MHz, an amplitude of 600 mVpp, 20 burst cycles, and an 80% duty cycle, along with a power amplifier (model 100A400A; AF Instrumentation, USA) set to 80% gain
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: The rats in the ST and MT groups underwent a 5-min ultrasound stimulation session a day, while the rats in SS, MS, and control groups were not stimulated by ultrasound.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: In this study, we introduce a groundbreaking wearable spiral ultrasound patch specifically designed for FUS peripheral neuromodulation to alleviate DNP. This innovative, stretchable ultrasound device can reliably deliver FUS to the peripheral nerves
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.pressure_kpa: The peak-to-peak acoustic pressures at the focal point of the w-SUP adhered to a flat plane, a 20<sup>◦</sup> curved surface, and a 40<sup>◦</sup> curved surface were 0.39 MPa, 0.45 MPa, and 0.44 MPa, respectively.

flags.reason: 30 rats were enrolled in five groups of 6; only the ST and MT groups (6 each) were sonicated, so the group sizes are listed.
ST group received one session, MT group 14 daily sessions.
Isppa and Ispta (357 and 277 mW/cm2) are given in the Discussion without a domain; the Methods equations include an FDA attenuation factor, so the values may be derated.
Pulse structure given as 20 cycles and 80% duty cycle; no PRF or pulse duration stated.
No PRF stated for the treatment sequence.
5 min stated as minutes; converted to 300 s.
SS and MS groups are described only as not stimulated by ultrasound; whether a patch was applied is not stated. A separate untreated control group existed.
Behaviour was video-recorded 'to ensure a blind experimental design' but blinding of the experimenters is not otherwise described.
PC12 cells and pork tissue were also exposed in safety and thermal tests; only the rat exposure is recorded.

provenance.notes: Peripheral thermal neuromodulation; the in-vivo exposure targets the sciatic nerve under ultrasound guidance.
